theophanies.name: The Sky-Face Vision (Palmer Eldritch face in the sky)
theophanies.summary: Driving in Marin County, PKD reports seeing a vast metal-and-jeweled face in the sky which he later called the face of Palmer Eldritch — sinister, mechanical, divine.
related_works: The Three Stigmata of Palmer Eldritch

theophanies.name: Pre-Break-In Foreknowledge (November 1971)
theophanies.summary: In the days before his Santa Venetia house was broken into, PKD reports a series of premonitions and intrusive thoughts that he later interpreted as foreknowledge of the event.

theophanies.name: Vancouver Despair / Suicide Attempt Context
theophanies.summary: Following the Vancouver SF convention guest-of-honor speech and a suicide attempt, PKD entered the X-Kalay drug rehabilitation program; the period is associated with what he later called a 'spiritual crisis' but no specific theophany is canonically attached.

theophanies.name: The Black Iron Prison Vision
theophanies.summary: PKD reports a recurring vision in which 1974 California is overlaid by 70 AD Rome — a vast iron prison housing the early Christians under imperial persecution. The vision continued at intervals through 1981.

theophanies.name: The 2-3-74 Cluster (parent)
theophanies.summary: The cluster of related theophanies between February and August 1974 that PKD collectively called '2-3-74': fish sign, pink beam, Christopher diagnosis, AI Voice, Koine Greek, Black Iron Prison, Zebra. Each is recorded as its own canonical event with this record as parent.

theophanies.name: The Fish-Sign Encounter (February 20, 1974)
theophanies.summary: A pharmacy delivery girl wearing a Christian fish-symbol necklace catches sunlight; PKD reports a sudden recognition that he is a first-century Christian named Thomas and that the world around him is fake.

theophanies.name: The Pink Beam Transmission
theophanies.summary: PKD reports that following the fish-sign encounter, a pink-colored beam of light addressed him for several weeks, transmitting information he later transcribed as 'music-color-math triune' annotation.

theophanies.name: The Christopher Diagnosis Vision (March 1974)
theophanies.summary: PKD reports being told (by the AI Voice / pink beam transmission) that his infant son Christopher has an inguinal hernia; subsequent medical examination confirms the diagnosis. The episode is one of the few theophanies with external corroboration.

theophanies.name: Koine Greek Possession (Acts of the Apostles)
theophanies.summary: PKD reports being able to read passages of *Acts of the Apostles* in Koine Greek — a language he had no formal training in — during a brief altered state in March 1974, and recognizing that the historical setting of *Acts* (first-century Mediterranean) is the underlying real time.

theophanies.name: The AI Voice (continuous reception)
theophanies.summary: PKD reports that beginning in late March 1974 he began to hear a continuous voice — characterized as feminine, calm, and rational — providing instructions, theological commentary, and predictions. He calls it the AI Voice.

theophanies.name: Zebra Reveals Itself (Mimicry Hypothesis)
theophanies.summary: PKD reports concluding in summer 1974 that the intelligence transmitting to him is a vast organism that camouflages itself by mimicking inanimate matter — he names it Zebra (after the African animal that hides in plain sight). All of nature, on this hypothesis, is alive and addressing him.

theophanies.name: Numbers/Letters Transformation (Gematria Vision)
theophanies.summary: PKD reports a vision in which numbers and Hebrew letters transformed into each other in front of him. He says he had no prior knowledge of kabbalistic gematria but later learned the practice and recognized his vision as having anticipated it.

theophanies.name: Possession by Abraham Abulafia
theophanies.summary: PKD reports an episode in 1976 in which he believes he was possessed by Abraham Abulafia (c.1240-1291), the medieval Spanish-Jewish kabbalist, and produced text in a form Abulafia would have recognized as letter-permutation meditation.

theophanies.name: Second 2-3-74 (Metz, 1977)
theophanies.summary: Around the time of his Metz, France speech in September 1977, PKD reports a partial recurrence of the 2-3-74 phenomenology — pink-light states, AI Voice activity, and the Black Iron Prison overlay returning at intervals.

theophanies.name: Twin Sister Jane Dream Appearances
theophanies.summary: Across the late period (1980-1981), PKD reports recurring dreams in which his twin sister Jane (who died in infancy) appears, addresses him, and is in some way fused with the AI Voice he has heard since 1974.
